decisionReason: All 8 existing checkpoints and all 6 trained B0 arms have now been measured under one protocol. The best result anywhere is parity on a map that cannot separate policies (delta 0.00), and the strongest network reading is delta -0.25 on that same map. Nothing beat HeuristicAI. G4 is not met.

evaluatedCandidates.note: strongest network reading in the project; still below the heuristic
byte-identical to budget_s2026.json; confirmed to score identically, so that run supplies one artifact, not two
identical score to the best checkpoint, so continued training neither helped nor hurt measurably

whatWasLearned.candidateCoverage: ALL measuresable candidates are now measured. No candidate beat the heuristic; the best is parity on a weakly-discriminating map.
whatWasLearned.oldPoolSeedsIndistinguishable: budget_s42, budget_s1337 and budget_s2026 all score exactly 0/4 with delta -0.50, so the three old-pool training seeds cannot be separated on this arena.
whatWasLearned.correctedPoolEqualsOldPool: v2_honest_s42 scores the same as budget_s42, so the V12 negative result neither transfers to nor is refuted by the corrected full-pool model.
whatWasLearned.bestNetworkReading: diag_grouped_s42 at delta -0.25 is the strongest network result in the project and still loses to the heuristic.
whatWasLearned.orderingDefect: Confirmed and quantified: teacher at stored candidate index 0 in 96.64% of rows vs engine-legal index 0 in 14.06-17.67%. Fixing it made the task learnable (22x chance) without producing strength.
whatWasLearned.teacherRoutesClosed: The heuristic is the teacher; the search that was supposed to be stronger IS the heuristic as shipped (120/120 identical), and recalibrated it misses free captures that the heuristic never misses.

recommendedNextStep: Decide the programme direction rather than adding another training variant. Every route so far reduces to copying the policy it must beat. Option (a): build a genuinely stronger teacher with a deterministic, capture-aware leaf and re-qualify it against v13/tools/teacher_tactical_suite.json. Option (b): stop the supervised branch and deliver the located negative results as the finding.
explicitlyNotClaimed: That diag_grouped_s42 is strong - delta -0.25 on one weakly-discriminating map is not strength
That the search teacher is qualified, at any configuration
That the 99% tiny-fit diagnostic was performed - it was not
